T: Adventure is out there. So is dessert.
D: A grumpy widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies to South America, with a young stowaway.
P: Serve dessert when Carl and Russell sit on the kerb with their ice creams.
S: the grape soda cap badge Ellie gives Carl
Grape juice set with gelatine in little round moulds, turned out and topped with a dot of whipped cream so they look like bottle caps.
Peanuts, raisins, choc chips, pretzels and banana chips tossed together and scooped into paper bags with a hand-drawn badge on each.
the house floating on thousands of balloons
Bocconcini rolled in different coloured coatings (paprika, herbs, black pepper, sesame), skewered on long picks like a bunch of balloons.
M: the explorer's dinner, served by his dogs
Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved, with a red wine sauce, roast potatoes and buttered greens, a very proper dinner in the clouds.
the South American cliffs Ellie always wanted to see
Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic, cumin and orange, grilled until charred, with black beans, rice and a mango salsa.
W: the giant bird who loves chocolate
Dark chocolate bark scattered with toasted hazelnuts, dried cherries and flaky salt, set and broken into shards. Save some for the bird.
K: Grape juice topped with soda water over ice, a squeeze of lime.

s.note: the grape soda cap badge Ellie gives Carl
s.how: Soak 6 gelatine leaves. Warm 500ml grape juice with 2 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon and stir in the gelatine. Set in small round moulds for 3 hours. Turn out and top each with a dot of whipped cream.
Toss 150g peanuts, 100g raisins, 80g choc chips, 100g pretzels and 80g banana chips together. Scoop into paper bags and draw a badge on each one. Adventure is out there.

m.note: the explorer's dinner, served by his dogs
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml stock and whisk in a knob of butter. Steam 300g green beans and toss in butter.

w.note: the giant bird who loves chocolate
w.how: Melt 300g dark chocolate and spread thin on a lined tray. Scatter with 60g toasted hazelnuts, 60g dried cherries and flaky salt. Set and break into shards. Save some for the bird.

d.how: Fill four glasses with ice. Pour 150ml grape juice into each and top with soda water. Add a squeeze of lime and hand them out with a grape soda badge.
